name: CKEditor 5 Aside
description: Updates CKEditor 5 to add an <aside> option to the headings list, letting editors mark a block as a semantic <aside>.
project_description:
CKEditor 5 Aside is a very small module that adds an
entry to the top of the CKEditor 5 heading dropdown. Selecting it wraps the current block in an
tag (for example swapping an

or

for

This is an aside
). While editing, the module ships a small admin stylesheet that floats and borders the aside so it is visible inside the editor; no styling is applied to the front-end theme, so you format the tag yourself. It works only for a single block with no nested tags, and does the one thing only. It provides no configuration UI, routes, permissions, PHP, or JavaScript of its own — it is purely a CKEditor 5 plugin definition (YAML) plus one CSS file.
